title: SSV Silver Gull — Settlements
description: City and town hubs: a full-screen view of the settlement with clickable interesting locations. Walk into a building and you land in a real battlemap with walls, lights and wandering NPCs; walk back out the door and you return to the hub. Interiors are generated from authored floorplans. Click a shopkeeper to trade. Press C to open the settlement view.

recommends.reason: Clicking a shopkeeper opens their shop.
Faction standing is shown in the settlement header.
Quest state can reveal hidden locations.
